description: This Java class implements a singleton factory for creating MQTT v3 clients using HiveMQ's MQTT client library. It provides methods to instantiate new clients and configure client builders based on connection parameters, reconnect policies, and event listeners.

classes.name: DefaultHiveMqtt3ClientFactory
classes.description: A singleton factory class to create and configure MQTT v3 clients for HiveMQ, implementing methods to generate new async clients and client builders.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of the factory.

methods.name: newClient
methods.description: Creates a new asynchronous MQTT client with specified connection parameters, event listeners, and logging.

methods.name: newClientBuilder
methods.description: Configures and returns an MQTT client builder based on connection details, event listeners, and authentication.
